cause_quote: The cutover made sessions.list call `await projection.ensureMaterialized()`, whose drain ran `const next = await params.getModelCatalog?.();` whenever the catalog was dirty, even with a usable snapshot in memory.
user_saw: Session lists sometimes took several seconds to load, and connected clients refetched model and chat metadata together after unchanged catalog renewals.
summary: The fix serves warm session reads from the resident catalog during renewal and suppresses metadata refetches when the catalog and refresh status are unchanged.
reasoning: Before #150196, the existing sessions.list RPC read already-published catalog snapshots without joining provider renewal. The cutover added a shared readiness drain that marked all rows dirty on catalog publications and made reads wait for the catalog read and row refresh, and #151290 filtered some publications while leaving that wait in place. The deferred-catalog test reproduced the wait, while production timings measured the whole drain, including row materialization.
